text:
maya: Starting rollout for release v2.3.1 to EU-west (change window). Initial 10% traffic shift now. Please watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and kvcache miss rate. deploy-bot will post events. Release notes: https://internal/redwood/release/v2.3.1 — includes a runtime kernel swap and cache optimizations.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Traffic shift to v2.3.1 = 10% | status: in-progress | job=deploy/rocket-eu-west | ts=1749004322

samir: Observability: dashboards show slight p95 rise on embed routes (~+40ms). still under SLO but trending. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/panel?view=eu-west-p95

lee: I'm seeing a small 5xx blip from embed-prod, ~0.08% (baseline ~0.01%). Can we hold traffic if it continues for 2 more mins?

jordan: I'll grab traces now and triage. tagging @opsbot for tail logs.

opsbot: opsbot: Collected tail logs for service embed-prod (last 2m). Matching error signature: "kv_cache_miss_on_hotpath". Sample snippet: ```trace_id=abc123 node=gpu-5 error="kv_cache_miss_on_hotpath" latency_ms=152```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Traffic shift to v2.3.1 = 25% | status: paused -> evaluating rollback policy | reason=error_burst | ts=1749004340

maya: Hold rollout at 25%. Do not rollback yet — investigate. Samir/Jordan, triage. If p95 > baseline +50ms or 5xx > 0.2% roll back to v2.3.0. Also pin routing for customer-critical routes: `/routes/pin embed-route:v2.3.0` (we can unpin after fix).

samir: Pinning in progress. Pinned embed-route to v2.3.0 for EU-west. (reacted :white_check_mark:)

jordan: Root cause looks like cache warmup after the kernel swap causing hotpath KV misses. Quick mitigation: increase kv-cache TTL to keep entries sticky. Proposed hotfix config: `kv_cache.ttl = 600s`. Want to canary in staging first?

lee: Agree with canary in staging. Hold rollout makes sense. If hotfix looks good in staging, resume with a smaller ramp (5% -> 15%).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout paused by human at 25% | automated rollback NOT triggered | ts=1749004375

maya: I'll update the release notes and notify support/docs. Flagging this release as 'hold for kernel-tweak'. We'll only rollback if thresholds are exceeded. Please add any triage logs to the INFRA ticket. Thanks. :handshake:

opsbot: opsbot: Created ticket INFRA-2147 for kv-cache tuning + followup perf check. link: https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/INFRA-2147

samir: ack, watching dashboards and will post short postmortem draft if we end up rolling back. :eyes:
